Data Class.H1: Does the class have other methods than getters and setters?
Data Class.H2: Does the class have other methods than its constructor?
Data Class.H3: Is the class data being externally manipulated?

Feature Envy.H1: Does the method call external methods too frequently?
Feature Envy.H2: Can you visualize an alternative implementation of this method focused on manipulating its own data?

God Class.H1: Does the class have clear responsibilities from other classes?
God Class.H2: Does it make sense for you to split this class into two or more classes?
God Class.H3: Does the class size hinder its readability/comprehensibility?

Long Parameter List.H1: Does the method signature have too many parameters?
Long Parameter List.H2: Are there too many parameters composed of complex types?
Long Parameter List.H3: Do the parameters’ names contribute to reaching a clear understanding of their purpose?
Long Parameter List.H4: 4-Does the method actually use all its parameters?
Long Parameter List.H6: May the parameters be passed more simply?

Middle Man.H1: Does the class perform any relevant logical task?
Middle Man.H2: Does the class clearly delegate its responsibilities to other classes?

Primitive Obsession.H1: Does replacing one or more primitive variables with objects sound to be the best choice?
Primitive Obsession.H2: May two or more variables be consolidated into a single complex type?

Refused Bequest.H1: Does the inheritance conceptually make sense?
Refused Bequest.H2: Does the class inherit methods never used?
Refused Bequest.H3: Does the class inherit methods that are not adherent with its definition?
Refused Bequest.H4: Are there too many methods being overridden?
